title: Turkey History Tracker Update — May 31, 2026
summary: Ousted CHP leader Özgür Özel drew tens of thousands in a defiance march to Atatürk's mausoleum in Ankara on May 30 — the largest opposition demonstration in over a decade — after riot police used water cannons against Özel supporters in İzmir on May 26. The Socialist International unanimously endorsed Özel as the legitimate CHP leader (May 27–29) and urged court-installed interim chair Kılıçdaroğlu to set a congress date. Kılıçdaroğlu vowed a 'clean, transparent' congress on May 31 but gave no specific date, with rival Ankara events cementing the CHP split. Foreign Policy (May 28) argued the judicial campaign may be consolidating rather than destroying the opposition. Istanbul Mayor İmamoğlu's espionage trial was adjourned to July 6; BIST-100 remains ~6% below pre-crisis levels with state banks having spent $6–8B defending the lira.

title: Turkey History Tracker Update — May 24, 2026
summary: The 36th Ankara Regional Court of Appeal on May 21 annulled the CHP's entire party leadership, removing chair Özgür Özel and reinstating former leader Kılıçdaroğlu as interim chair — the most dramatic judicial blow to Turkey's opposition in decades. The ruling triggered a 6%+ BIST-100 stock drop, mass protests across Istanbul, Ankara, and İzmir, and condemnation from the EU, US State Department, Council of Europe, and Human Rights Watch. Turkey's EFES-2026 military exercise concluded with Syria and Libya joining for historic firsts, while FM Fidan and Secretary Rubio held bilateral talks at the NATO Helsingborg ministerial ahead of the July Ankara summit. The lira hit record lows past 45.5/USD as April inflation came in above consensus at 32.37%.
